title: Order of Operations
setup: Black has thrown three pawns forward and the king is still at home. Two of your pieces want the same corner.
hint: Your queen and your bishop can each reach the diagonal that ends at the black king. Ask which of them the rook on h6 can take.
explanation:
## The Idea

The queen on d1 and the bishop on d3 both want the diagonal to e8, and only one order works.

{{Qxh5+}} goes first. Blocking with {{Rg6}} loses at once, and after {{Rxh5}} the rook has left the sixth rank, so nothing guards g6: {{Bg6#}}. The bishop covers f7, and the king's own pawns, queen and bishop fill the rest.

Start with the bishop and {{Bg6+}} is met by {{Rxg6}}. Touch-move will not let you change your mind.
